title: Choosing a Work Shirt
situation: A customer is buying a shirt for work, asks for medium in light blue, tries it on, checks the fit and price, and decides to buy it.
somali_situation: Macmiil ayaa iibsanaya shaati shaqo, wuxuu weydiinayaa cabbir dhexdhexaad ah oo buluug khafiif ah, wuu tijaabinayaa, le'ekaanta iyo qiimaha hubinayaa, kadibna wuu iibsanayaa.
key_phrases: I'm looking for a shirt for work.
Medium, please.
Can I try it on?
The sleeves are a good length.
It is twenty-five dollars.
I'll take it.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Hi, I'm looking for a shirt for work.
dialogue.somali: Salaan, waxaan raadinayaa shaati aan shaqada u xirto.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: Certainly. What size do you usually wear?
dialogue.somali: Hubaal. Cabbirkee ayaad badanaa xirataa?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Medium, please. Do you have a light blue one?
dialogue.somali: Dhexdhexaad, fadlan. Mid buluug khafiif ah ma haysaan?

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: Yes, this one is cotton and good for office wear.
dialogue.somali: Haa, kan waa suuf, wuuna ku fiican yahay dhar xafiis.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Great. Can I try it on?
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay. Ma tijaabin karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: Yes, the fitting room is just behind the mirror.
dialogue.somali: Haa, qolka tijaabadu wuxuu ku yaal muraayadda gadaasheeda.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: It fits well, and the sleeves are a good length.
dialogue.somali: Si fiican ayuu ii le'eg yahay, gacmuhuna dherer fiican ayay leeyihiin.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: I'm glad it fits. It is twenty-five dollars.
dialogue.somali: Waan ku faraxsanahay inuu kuu le'eg yahay. Waa shan iyo labaatan doolar.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: That is fine. I'll take it.
dialogue.somali: Waa hagaag. Waan qaadanayaa.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: Perfect. I'll fold it and put it in a bag.
dialogue.somali: Waa hagaag. Waan kuu laabi doonaa, boorsana waan kuugu ridi doonaa.

title: Checking Waist and Length
situation: A customer needs black work trousers; the waist fits, but the legs are too long, so the assistant offers a hem alteration.
somali_situation: Macmiil ayaa u baahan surwaal madow oo shaqo; dhexdu way ku habboon tahay, laakiin luguhu way dheer yihiin, markaa shaqaalaha dukaanku wuxuu soo jeedinayaa in geeska la gaabiyo.
key_phrases: The waist feels right, but the legs are too long.
We can shorten this pair.
Would the alteration show on the outside?
Can he pin them while I am wearing my shoes?
I'll take them with the alteration.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Hi, I need black trousers for work.
dialogue.somali: Salaan, waxaan u baahanahay surwaal madow oo aan shaqada u xirto.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: No problem. What waist size are you?
dialogue.somali: Dhib ma leh. Cabbirka dhexdaadu waa imisa?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Thirty-two. The length is usually the problem for me.
dialogue.somali: Soddon iyo laba. Badanaa dhererka ayaa igu dhib badan.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: Try this pair. The waist is thirty-two and the inside leg is regular.
dialogue.somali: Kan tijaabi. Dhexdu waa soddon iyo laba, dhererka lugtuna waa caadi.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: The waist feels right, but the legs are too long.
dialogue.somali: Dhexdu way igu habboon tahay, laakiin luguhu aad bay iigu dheer yihiin.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: We are out of the shorter length, but we can shorten this pair.
dialogue.somali: Dhererkii ka gaabnaa wuu naga dhammaaday, laakiin kan waan kuu gaabin karnaa.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Would the alteration show on the outside?
dialogue.somali: Hagaajintu bannaanka ma ka muuqan doontaa?

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: No, the tailor will keep the original hem. He can pin them now.
dialogue.somali: Maya, dawaarluhu geeskii hore ayuu ilaalinayaa. Hadda ayuu calaamadeyn karaa.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: All right. Can he pin them while I am wearing my shoes?
dialogue.somali: Waa hagaag. Ma calaamadeyn karaa anigoo kabahayga xiran?

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: Yes, that gives the best length. They will be ready tomorrow afternoon.
dialogue.somali: Haa, taas ayaa dhererka ugu fiican bixinaysa. Berri galab ayay diyaar noqonayaan.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Great. I'll take them with the alteration.
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay. Waan qaadanayaa iyadoo la gaabinayo.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: I'll ask the tailor to come over now.
dialogue.somali: Hadda ayaan dawaarlaha u yeerayaa.

title: Trying Shoes for Comfort
situation: A customer needs comfortable black shoes for long work shifts, tries one pair, finds it tight at the toes, and chooses a wider pair.
somali_situation: Macmiil ayaa u baahan kabo madow oo raaxo leh oo shaqo dheer lagu istaago, hal nooc ayuu tijaabinayaa, faraha ayuu ka ciriiri ka dareemayaa, kadibna wuxuu dooranayaa nooc ka ballaaran.
key_phrases: Hi, do you have these shoes in size eight?
Can I walk around in them for a moment?
The heel feels fine, but they are tight around my toes.
I can bring a wider pair in the same size.
This pair feels much better, and the sole is not too hard.
I'll take this pair.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Hi, do you have these shoes in size eight?
dialogue.somali: Salaan, kabahan cabbir siddeed ma haysaan?

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: Yes, we do. Are they for work or everyday wear?
dialogue.somali: Haa, waan haynaa. Ma shaqo ayaad ugu baahan tahay mise xirasho maalinle ah?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: For work. I stand for most of the day, so they need to be comfortable.
dialogue.somali: Shaqo. Inta badan maalinta waan taagnaadaa, markaa waa inay raaxo leeyihiin.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: Then try this black pair first. The sole has good support.
dialogue.somali: Markaa marka hore tijaabi kuwan madow. Salka kabtu taageero fiican ayuu leeyahay.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Can I walk around in them for a moment?
dialogue.somali: Cabbaar ma ku socon karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: Of course. Walk to the mirror and back, and check the heel too.
dialogue.somali: Dabcan. Muraayadda u soco oo soo noqo, ciribtana hubi.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: The heel feels fine, but they are tight around my toes.
dialogue.somali: Ciribtu way fiican tahay, laakiin faraha ayay iga ciriiri yihiin.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: I can bring a wider pair in the same size.
dialogue.somali: Labo ka ballaaran oo isla cabbirka ah ayaan kuu keeni karaa.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Please do. I like the plain style, but I cannot wear tight shoes all day.
dialogue.somali: Fadlan keen. Nooca fudud waan jeclahay, laakiin kabo ciriiri ah maalinta oo dhan ma xiran karo.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: Here is the wider pair. The leather is softer, and the laces can be loosened.
dialogue.somali: Waa kuwan kuwa ka ballaaran. Maqaarkoodu wuu ka jilicsan yahay, xarigahana waa la dabcin karaa.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: This pair feels much better, and the sole is not too hard.
dialogue.somali: Kuwani aad bay uga fiican yihiin, salkuna aad uma adka.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: Good. Would you like to wear them out or keep them in the box?
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay. Ma hadda ayaad xiranaysaa mise sanduuqa ayaan kuugu reebaa?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: I'll keep them in the box. I'll take this pair.
dialogue.somali: Sanduuqa ha ku jiraan. Labadan ayaan qaadanayaa.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: Great choice. I'll add the spare laces as well.
dialogue.somali: Doorasho fiican. Xarigaha dheeraadka ahna waan ku dari doonaa.

title: Matching a Belt and Wallet
somali_title: Isku aadinta suun iyo boorso yar
situation: A customer wants a belt to match brown shoes, compares leather belts and wallets, checks the belt fit, asks about a set price, and chooses a gift.
somali_situation: Macmiil ayaa rabaya suun la jaanqaada kabo bunni ah, wuxuu isbarbardhigayaa suunno iyo boorsooyin maqaar ah, le'ekaanta suunka hubinayaa, qiimaha set-ka weydiinayaa, kadibna hadiyad dooranayaa.
key_phrases: I'm looking for a belt to match these brown shoes.
Is it real leather, or is it synthetic?
Which one goes better with the belt?
Can I check the size?
Is there a set price if I buy both?
I'll take the belt and the slim wallet.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: I'm looking for a belt to match these brown shoes.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan raadinayaa suun la jaanqaada kabahan bunni ah.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: Then I would avoid black. This dark brown one is closer.
dialogue.somali: Markaa madowga waan ka fogaan lahaa. Kan bunni madowga ah ayaa uga dhow.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Is it real leather, or is it synthetic?
dialogue.somali: Ma maqaar dhab ah baa, mise waa maqaar sameys ah?

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: It is real leather. The buckle is brushed metal, so it is not too shiny.
dialogue.somali: Waa maqaar dhab ah. Qabsaduhu waa bir aan aad u dhalaalayn, markaa ma aha mid si badan u ifaya.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Can I check the size? I usually wear a thirty-four waist.
dialogue.somali: Cabbirka ma hubin karaa? Badanaa dhexda soddon iyo afar ayaan xirtaa.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: This size should work. You still have two holes if you need it tighter.
dialogue.somali: Cabbirkani wuu kugu habboonaanayaa. Laba dalool oo kale ayaa kuu haraya haddii aad u baahato inuu kugu adkaado.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: I'd also like a wallet for a gift. Which one goes better with the belt?
dialogue.somali: Boorso yar oo hadiyad ahna waan rabaa. Tee ayaa suunka si fiican ula jaanqaadaysa?

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: The slim wallet matches the colour. The larger one has more card slots.
dialogue.somali: Boorsada khafiifka ah midabka ayay la jaanqaadaysaa. Tan weynna boos badan ayay kaararka u leedahay.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: The slim one looks neater. It will fit easily in a jacket pocket.
dialogue.somali: Tan khafiifka ah ayaa qurux badan. Si fudud ayay jeebka jaakad ugu geli kartaa.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: The belt is twenty dollars, and the slim wallet is eighteen.
dialogue.somali: Suunku waa labaatan doolar, boorsada khafiifka ahna waa siddeed iyo toban.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Is there a set price if I buy both?
dialogue.somali: Haddii aan labadaba iibsado qiimo set ah ma jiraa?

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: Yes, I can make it thirty-three dollars for the belt and wallet.
dialogue.somali: Haa, suunka iyo boorsada waxaan ka dhigi karaa soddon iyo saddex doolar.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: That sounds fair. I'll take the belt and the slim wallet.
dialogue.somali: Taasi waa cadaalad. Suunka iyo boorsada khafiifka ah ayaan qaadanayaa.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: Would you like me to remove the price tags?
dialogue.somali: Ma rabtaa inaan qiimaha ka saaro?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Yes, please. They are a gift for my brother.
dialogue.somali: Haa, fadlan. Waa hadiyad aan walaalkay u wado.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: No problem. I'll wrap them together in a small box.
dialogue.somali: Dhib ma leh. Hal sanduuq yar ayaan si wadajir ah kuugu duubi doonaa.

title: Choosing a Jacket Colour
situation: A customer wants a casual jacket, compares black, blue, and grey, and chooses the colour that matches their trousers.
somali_situation: Macmiil ayaa rabaya jaakad caadi ah, wuxuu isbarbardhigayaa madow, buluug, iyo cawl, kadibna dooranayaa midabka surwaalkiisa la jaanqaada.
key_phrases: What colours does this jacket come in?
Can I see the grey one?
I like the grey one.
It matches my black trousers.
The grey jacket is better for me.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: What colours does this jacket come in?
dialogue.somali: Jaakaddan midabadee lagu heli karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: It comes in black, blue, and grey.
dialogue.somali: Waxaa lagu heli karaa madow, buluug, iyo cawl.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Can I see the grey one?
dialogue.somali: Kan cawlka ah ma arki karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: Here it is. It is softer than the black one.
dialogue.somali: Waa kan. Wuxuu ka deggan yahay kan madow.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: I like the grey one. It matches my black trousers.
dialogue.somali: Kan cawlka ah waan jeclahay. Wuxuu la jaanqaadayaa surwaalkayga madow.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: The blue one is brighter if you want something more casual.
dialogue.somali: Kan buluugga ah wuu ka muuqaal badan yahay haddii aad rabto wax ka caadi ah.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: No, the grey jacket is better for me.
dialogue.somali: Maya, jaakadda cawlka ah ayaa ii fiican.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: Good choice. I'll bring the grey jacket in your size.
dialogue.somali: Doorasho fiican. Jaakadda cawlka ah ayaan cabbirkaaga kuugu keenayaa.

title: Changing from Medium to Large
somali_title: Ka beddelashada dhexdhexaad una gudub weyn
situation: A customer tries a medium hoodie, finds it tight across the shoulders, changes to a large, and decides the larger size fits better.
somali_situation: Macmiil ayaa tijaabinaya funaanad koofiyad leh oo cabbirkeedu dhexdhexaad yahay, garbaha ayay ka ciriiri noqotaa, cabbir weyn ayuu tijaabiyaa, kadibna wuxuu go'aansadaa in weynku si fiican ugu le'eg yahay.
key_phrases: I tried the medium hoodie, but it is too tight across the shoulders.
Would you like to try a larger size?
Do you have a large in the same colour?
Does it look too baggy?
I'll take the large.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: I tried the medium hoodie, but it is too tight across the shoulders.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan tijaabiyay funaanadda koofiyadda leh ee dhexdhexaadka ah, laakiin garbaha ayay iga ciriiri tahay.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: Would you like to try a larger size?
dialogue.somali: Ma rabtaa inaad tijaabiso cabbir ka weyn?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Yes, please. Do you have a large in the same colour?
dialogue.somali: Haa, fadlan. Mid weyn oo isla midabka ah ma haysaan?

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: Yes, here it is. You can use the same fitting room.
dialogue.somali: Haa, waa kan. Isla qolka tijaabada ayaad isticmaali kartaa.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: This feels better. Does it look too baggy?
dialogue.somali: Kani wuu ka fiican yahay. Ma wuxuu u muuqdaa inuu aad u ballaaran yahay?

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: No, it sits well. The medium looked tight when you moved your arms.
dialogue.somali: Maya, si fiican ayuu kuu saaran yahay. Kii dhexdhexaadka ahaa wuu ciriiri u muuqday markaad gacmaha dhaqaajisay.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Then the large is the right size for me.
dialogue.somali: Markaa cabbirka weyn ayaa ii sax ah.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: I agree. It gives you room to move without looking loose.
dialogue.somali: Waan kugu raacsanahay. Wuxuu ku siinayaa meel aad ku dhaqaaqdo, adigoon u muuqan mid aad u ballaaran.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Great. I'll take the large.
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay. Cabbirka weyn ayaan qaadanayaa.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: I'll put the medium back and take this one to the till.
dialogue.somali: Kii dhexdhexaadka ahaa waan celinayaa, kan weynna qasnadda ayaan geynayaa.

title: Comparing Clothes and Prices
situation: A customer compares a linen shirt and a wool sweater, tries both on, asks about the sale price and return policy, and chooses the sweater.
somali_situation: Macmiil ayaa isbarbardhigaya shaati linen ah iyo funaanad dhogor ah, labadaba tijaabinaya, qiimaha dhimista iyo siyaasadda soo celinta weydiinaya, kadibna funaanadda dooranaya.
key_phrases: Which one is cheaper?
The wool is soft, not scratchy.
Can I try both on before I choose?
What is the return policy if I change my mind?
I'll buy the sweater.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: I'm deciding between this linen shirt and this wool sweater.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan kala dooranayaa shaatigan linenka ah iyo funaanaddan dhogorta ah.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: The shirt is lighter, but the sweater will be warmer in the evening.
dialogue.somali: Shaatigu wuu ka khafiifsan yahay, laakiin funaanaddu fiidkii way ka diirran tahay.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Which one is cheaper?
dialogue.somali: Kee ayaa ka jaban?

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: The shirt is twelve dollars. The sweater was twenty, but it is sixteen today.
dialogue.somali: Shaatigu waa laba iyo toban doolar. Funaanaddu labaatan ayay ahayd, laakiin maanta waa lix iyo toban.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Can I try both on before I choose?
dialogue.somali: Labadaba ma tijaabin karaa ka hor inta aanan dooran?

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: Yes, the fitting room is on the left.
dialogue.somali: Haa, qolka tijaabadu bidix ayuu ku yaal.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: The shirt fits well, but the sweater looks better with my jeans.
dialogue.somali: Shaatigu si fiican ayuu ii le'eg yahay, laakiin funaanaddu surwaalkayga jiinka ah ayay si fiican ula egtahay.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: It is a good choice. The wool is soft, not scratchy.
dialogue.somali: Waa doorasho fiican. Dhogortu way jilicsan tahay, mana xoqayso.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: What is the return policy if I change my mind?
dialogue.somali: Haddii aan go'aankayga beddelo, siyaasadda soo celintu waa sidee?

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: You can return it within fourteen days with the receipt.
dialogue.somali: Waxaad soo celin kartaa afar iyo toban maalmood gudahood adigoo rasiidka wata.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: All right, I'll buy the sweater.
dialogue.somali: Waa hagaag, funaanadda ayaan iibsanayaa.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: I'll ring it up with the discount.
dialogue.somali: Qiimo dhimista ayaan kula xisaabinayaa.

title: Dropping Off Laundry
situation: A customer leaves clothes for cleaning, explains a stain and delicate fabric, asks about price and collection time, and receives a receipt.
somali_situation: Macmiil ayaa dhar nadiifin loo keenay, wasakh iyo maro jilicsan sharxaya, qiimaha iyo waqtiga qaadashada weydiinaya, kadibna rasiid helaya.
key_phrases: I'd like to drop off these clothes for cleaning.
I see a stain on the sleeve.
Please be careful with the fabric; it's quite delicate.
When will they be ready for collection?
Could I have a receipt?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Good afternoon. I'd like to drop off these clothes for cleaning.
dialogue.somali: Galab wanaagsan. Dharkan waxaan rabaa in la ii nadiifiyo.

dialogue.speaker: Laundry attendant
dialogue.english: Of course. Are they for washing or dry cleaning?
dialogue.somali: Haye. Ma dhaqis caadi ah baa mise nadiifin qalalan?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: The shirts can be washed, but this jacket needs dry cleaning.
dialogue.somali: Shaatiyada waa la dhaqi karaa, laakiin jaakaddan nadiifin qalalan ayay u baahan tahay.

dialogue.speaker: Laundry attendant
dialogue.english: I see a stain on the sleeve. Do you know what caused it?
dialogue.somali: Wasakh ayaan ka arkayaa gacanta. Ma ogtahay waxa keenay?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: It's coffee. Please be careful with the fabric; it's quite delicate.
dialogue.somali: Waa qaxwo. Fadlan marada si taxaddar leh ula dhaqan; way jilicsan tahay.

dialogue.speaker: Laundry attendant
dialogue.english: We will treat the stain first and clean the jacket separately.
dialogue.somali: Marka hore wasakhda ayaan daaweyn doonaa, jaakaddana gooni ayaan u nadiifin doonaa.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: How much will everything cost?
dialogue.somali: Dhammaan immisa ayay noqonayaan?

dialogue.speaker: Laundry attendant
dialogue.english: The shirts are six dollars, and the jacket is twelve.
dialogue.somali: Shaatiyadu waa lix doolar, jaakadduna waa laba iyo toban.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: When will they be ready for collection?
dialogue.somali: Goorma ayay diyaar u noqonayaan inaan qaato?

dialogue.speaker: Laundry attendant
dialogue.english: Tomorrow after four. The jacket may need a little more time if the stain remains.
dialogue.somali: Berri afarta ka dib. Jaakadda waqti yar oo dheeraad ah ayay u baahan kartaa haddii wasakhdu harto.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: That's fine. Could I have a receipt?
dialogue.somali: Waa hagaag. Rasiid ma heli karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Laundry attendant
dialogue.english: Here you are. You'll need this receipt when you collect the clothes.
dialogue.somali: Waa kan. Rasiidkan ayaad u baahan doontaa marka aad dharka qaadanayso.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Should I pay now or when I pick them up?
dialogue.somali: Hadda miyaan bixiyaa mise marka aan qaadanayo?

dialogue.speaker: Laundry attendant
dialogue.english: You can pay when you collect them.
dialogue.somali: Waxaad bixin kartaa marka aad qaadanayso.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Great. I'll come tomorrow evening.
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay. Berri fiidkii ayaan imaan doonaa.

dialogue.speaker: Laundry attendant
dialogue.english: We'll have them ready for you.
dialogue.somali: Diyaar ayaan kuugu hayn doonaa.

title: Shortening Trousers
situation: A customer brings trousers to a tailor because they are too long, asks for them to be shortened, checks the price, and asks when they will be ready.
somali_situation: Macmiil ayaa surwaal u keenaya dawaarle sababtoo ah aad buu u dheer yahay, wuxuu codsanayaa in la gaabiyo, qiimaha hubinayaa, kadibna weydiinayaa goorta uu diyaar noqonayo.
key_phrases: These trousers are too long.
Can you shorten them?
I can mark the hem in the right place.
How much will it cost?
When will they be ready?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Hello. These trousers are too long. Can you shorten them?
dialogue.somali: Salaan. Surwaalkan aad buu ii dheer yahay. Ma gaabin kartaa?

dialogue.speaker: Tailor
dialogue.english: Yes. Please put them on so I can measure the length.
dialogue.somali: Haa. Fadlan xiro si aan dhererka u cabbiro.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Should I wear my shoes?
dialogue.somali: Kabahayga ma xirtaa?

dialogue.speaker: Tailor
dialogue.english: Yes, please. Then I can mark the hem in the right place.
dialogue.somali: Haa, fadlan. Markaas geeska meel sax ah ayaan ka calaamadeyn karaa.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: How much will it cost?
dialogue.somali: Immisa ayay ku kacaysaa?

dialogue.speaker: Tailor
dialogue.english: Six dollars.
dialogue.somali: Lix doolar.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: When will they be ready?
dialogue.somali: Goorma ayay diyaar noqonayaan?

dialogue.speaker: Tailor
dialogue.english: Tomorrow afternoon. You can try them on before you leave.
dialogue.somali: Berri galab. Waad tijaabin kartaa ka hor intaadan bixin.

title: Buying Warm Clothes for Rain
somali_title: Iibsashada dhar diirran oo roobka ku habboon
situation: A customer needs a warm waterproof jacket for rain, checks the hood and size, then adds waterproof gloves.
somali_situation: Macmiil ayaa u baahan jaakad diirran oo biyaha celisa xilli roobaad, wuxuu hubinayaa koofiyadda iyo cabbirka, kadibna wuxuu ku darayaa gacmo-gashi biyaha celiya.
key_phrases: I need something warm for rainy weather.
Is this jacket waterproof enough for heavy rain?
Can I try a large?
Do you have gloves in medium as well?
I'll take both, the jacket and the gloves.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: I need something warm for rainy weather.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan u baahanahay wax diirran oo roobka ku habboon.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: This jacket is waterproof and has a warm lining.
dialogue.somali: Jaakaddan biyaha way celisaa, gudaha ayayna diirran tahay.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Is this jacket waterproof enough for heavy rain?
dialogue.somali: Jaakaddani ma ku filan tahay roob culus?

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: Yes. It also has a hood you can tighten when it is windy.
dialogue.somali: Haa. Waxay kaloo leedahay koofiyad aad adkayn karto marka dabayl jirto.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Can I try a large?
dialogue.somali: Cabbir weyn ma tijaabin karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: Here you are. It should leave room for a sweater underneath.
dialogue.somali: Waa kan. Waa inuu boos u reebaa funaanad dhogor ah oo hoosta laga xirto.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: It feels warm, but not too heavy.
dialogue.somali: Way diirran tahay, laakiin aad uma cusla.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: We also have waterproof gloves near the counter.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan sidoo kale haynaa gacmo-gashi biyaha celiya oo miiska agtiisa yaal.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Do you have gloves in medium as well?
dialogue.somali: Gacmo-gashi cabbir dhexdhexaad ahna ma haysaan?

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: Yes, here they are.
dialogue.somali: Haa, waa kuwan.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: I'll take both, the jacket and the gloves.
dialogue.somali: Labadaba waan qaadanayaa, jaakadda iyo gacmo-gashiga.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: Good choice. They should keep you dry and warm.
dialogue.somali: Doorasho fiican. Waxay kaa ilaalin doonaan qoyaan iyo qabow.
